detail.longDescription: Productivity is one of the least discussed but most important economic concepts. Higher productivity means producing more value with the same resources. Over time, it is what allows wages and living standards to rise. Part 2 of the series examines why economists care so much about productivity. # Economics # Productivity # Australia # EconomicGrowth https:// travis.nice.id.au/productivity -isnt-everything-in-the-long-run-its-almost-everything
